name: ga-vat-gst
description: Gabon VAT reference for domestic taxable activity, registration thresholds, ordinary monthly returns, invoice evidence and the 2026 finance-law changes. Use for TVA, imported services, reduced rates, zero rating, nonresident digital suppliers and the separate solidarity contribution. Use this Guide to identify the facts, statutory computation and source documents needed before preparing a working paper. It separates the historical code baseline from the enacted finance-law amendments read for this draft. It does not certify the complete 2026 amendment chain or authenticated filing screens. Missing procedures and unresolved old topics are listed explicitly, and the pack remains partial until those gaps and independent review are complete.
